  have der' : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => simp at mem
  case abs => exact .inl (.abs der'.wf.2.1)
  case tabs => exact .inl (.tabs der'.wf.2.1)
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl l with val_l | ⟨t₁', red_l⟩
    · rcases ih_r rfl r with val_r | ⟨t₂', red_r⟩
      · obtain ⟨σ, s, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
        exact ⟨_, .abs val_l.lc val_r⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .appᵣ val_l red_r⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 red_l⟩
  case tapp σ' der sub ih =>
    right
    have lc := (Sub.wf _ _ _ sub).2.1.lc
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    · obtain ⟨σ, s, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val

    · exact ⟨_, .tapp lc red⟩
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der _ ih _ =>

    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t₁', red⟩

    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t', red⟩
